feature_dictionary: local official flood reports in trailing3months, exact unique dictionary identity
national official key-rate signed ppchanges in trailing3months
history_features: own difference1/3/5 normalized to last known at origin-2
training: Expanding windows, target<=currentorigin-2, equal weight per training origin, normalized ridgealpha1, minimum4origins; no geography pooling as independent event replication
mask: 1896 complete-panel MO intersect exact frozen R9 mask separately for h1/h3; all arms identical rows
limits: Previously viewed 2024 window; freeze before computation is not scientific preregistration or unseen holdout
Proxy uses claimed official publication month, not unverified historic available_at. Strict arm0eligible does not prove no news existed
Only six records, five sources, four months, one flood family and national rates. Municipal rows are not independent news observations
No national event duplicated as thousands of independent replications; month descriptive intervals only
Sparse training exposure can make coefficients zero. No tuned hyperparameters, feature selection or winner-picked model
Not causal disaster/rate effects or economic-event ground truth; no real early-warning claim
One/twelve-month delay checks encode availability sensitivity, not fake events or backdated first_seen
Forecast quality pertains to this fixed linear algorithm, not all possible news models
